subject: SPEC-034: Hierarchical Memory Tag System
description:
Implement hierarchical tag system for memories, allowing nested tags and tag categories to organize memories across user, team, and organization contexts.

**Requirements:**
- Support nested tag structures (parent-child relationships)
- Tag category management
- Tag hierarchy visualization
- Multi-level tag filtering

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Users can create hierarchical tags
- Tags can be nested up to 3 levels
- Tag hierarchy is preserved across contexts
- API endpoints support hierarchical tag operations

subject: SPEC-034: Advanced Search by Labels API
description:
Implement advanced search functionality that allows users to search memories by multiple labels/tags with boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT).

**Requirements:**
- Multi-tag search with boolean logic
- Label-based filtering
- Search result ranking by relevance
- Performance optimization for large tag sets

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Users can search with multiple tags using AND/OR/NOT
- Search queries support complex boolean expressions
- Results are ranked by relevance
- Search response time <500ms for typical queries

subject: SPEC-034: Multi-Context Tag Management
description:
Enable tag management across different contexts (user-level, team-level, organization-level) with proper access control and visibility.

**Requirements:**
- Context-aware tag creation and management
- Tag visibility based on context scope
- Tag inheritance and sharing mechanisms
- ACL integration for tag access control

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Tags can be created at user/team/org levels
- Tag visibility respects context boundaries
- Tag sharing between contexts works correctly
- ACL policies apply to tag operations

subject: SPEC-034: Tag Filter UI Components
description:
Build frontend UI components for tag filtering, tag selection, and tag-based memory browsing in the customer and admin consoles.

**Requirements:**
- Tag filter dropdown/selector
- Multi-select tag filtering
- Tag cloud visualization
- Tag-based memory list view

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Users can filter memories by tags in UI
- Tag selector supports multi-select
- Tag cloud displays popular tags
- Filtered results update in real-time

subject: SPEC-034: Tag ACL and Visibility Rules
description:
Implement access control and visibility rules for tags, ensuring users can only see and manage tags they have permission to access.

**Requirements:**
- Tag-level ACL enforcement
- Visibility rules based on context
- Permission checks for tag operations
- Integration with SPEC-043 (Memory ACL)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Users can only see tags they have access to
- Tag creation respects permission boundaries
- Tag modifications require appropriate permissions
- ACL rules are enforced across all tag operations

subject: SPEC-034: Tag Management Tests
description:
Create comprehensive test suite for SPEC-034 features including unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests for tag operations.

**Requirements:**
- Unit tests for tag hierarchy operations
- Integration tests for search functionality
- E2E tests for tag management workflows
- Performance tests for large tag sets

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Test coverage >90% for tag operations
- All integration tests pass
- E2E tests cover critical workflows
- Performance tests validate query optimization
